tasks.short: Organize, check, adjust and weight raw data

steps.what: Inspect actual source extracts and dictionaries and define and check the organization, edit, adjustment and weighting specifications
inputs: Actual study protocol and sampling information
outputs: Checked source contract and statistician-authored processing and weighting specification

steps.what: Organize actual source records into the specified schema and preserve source identifiers and transformation lineage
inputs: Actual extracts and checked source contract from s1
outputs: Organized draft data and schema exceptions with lineage

steps.what: Run the specified range, consistency, duplicate and missingness checks on organized data
outputs: Explicit discrepancy listing and check totals

steps.what: Investigate discrepancies against actual source records and record justified adjustments or unresolved queries
inputs: Actual source records and approved adjustment specification
outputs: Reviewed adjustment instructions and unresolved exceptions

steps.what: Apply the explicitly approved adjustments and weighting rules to a derived draft dataset without changing raw sources
outputs: Derived weighted draft dataset, weight diagnostics and transformation log

steps.what: Reconcile record counts, adjustments, source lineage and weight diagnostics and check the complete final derived dataset
inputs: Derived draft dataset and transformation log
outputs: Final checked derived dataset or withheld exception batch

steps.what: Save the final checked derived dataset and processing log in the existing analysis workspace
inputs: Final checked derived dataset and log
outputs: Saved derived dataset and log

tasks.design: Build a deterministic preparation pipeline in {DATA_PLATFORM} from the statistician's actual source and weighting specification. Organization, edit checks and applying approved adjustments each have explicit machine steps; discrepancy judgment and final reconciliation remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated schema handling, edit-check preparation and application of approved transformations can be performed manually between extracts.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned data pipelines can execute exact transformations with lineage and explicit exception output.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a discrepancy is an error and whether an adjustment or weighting method is defensible.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician understands the study and judges methodological consequences.

ambition.what: Reprocess new extracts consistently after source and specification checks.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5; data and study owners authorize extracts and derived-data access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: statistical data pipelines can organize records, execute explicit edit checks and apply approved weighting formulas with lineage.

assumptions: Data owners supply actual extracts and dictionaries and study owners supply actual sampling information; s1 checks completeness, units, identifiers and permitted use. No clean source feed or data collection is assumed free.

All adjustments and weighting rules are authored and checked by the statistician; unresolved discrepancies stop affected output. Raw source records are not overwritten and no source-data query is silently sent.
s2, s3 and s5 replace currently manual repeated processing setup and handling, not statistical-engine runtime. Equivalent existing pipelines earn no additional gain.
Illustrative gross saving 50 per 100 task hours, upkeep 5, net 45. Same-workspace save has no gain; source data collection is retained in its actual producing workflow.
unknowns: Current pipeline coverage and actual exception burden
research_questions: Which extract preparation and weighting operations are manually reconstructed today despite stable specifications?

already_counted.description: Check source and method contracts, investigate exceptions and reconcile the final weighted dataset

incremental.description: Maintain versioned mappings and edit rules and validate changed weighting code

approvals.approved_version: Complete derived dataset and processing log checked in s6; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured repeated-extract scenario with manual processing setup today; source, exception and final checks retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and test statistical designs and methods

steps.what: Define the actual research question, estimand, practical constraints and criteria for evaluating experimental or sampling designs
inputs: Actual study question, protocol and practical constraints
outputs: Checked design brief and evaluation criteria

steps.what: Develop candidate experimental designs, sampling techniques and analytical methods and specify their assumptions and test scenarios
outputs: Statistician-authored candidate methods and simulation scenarios

steps.what: Implement and check candidate designs using existing tested statistical-package functions and reusable simulation harnesses
inputs: Actual candidate methods and scenarios from s2
Existing tested package functions and harnesses
outputs: Checked candidate implementations and explicit scenario manifest

steps.what: Prepare and run the specified scenario batches and collect statistical operating-characteristic outputs reproducibly
inputs: Checked implementations and explicit scenario manifest from s3
outputs: Scenario-indexed test outputs, seeds and failure listing

steps.what: Check implementation against benchmark cases, inspect all failures and sensitivity results and write and check the actual design recommendation
outputs: Final checked design comparison and recommendation

steps.what: Save the final checked design comparison and reproducible test record in the same analysis workspace
inputs: Final checked design comparison and test record
outputs: Saved design and test record

tasks.design: Configure tested statistical functions and reusable scenario harnesses in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The statistician develops the methods and scenarios, checks the implementations and interprets tests before saving the final comparison.
tasks.previous_blocker: Candidate implementations and scenario batches may be reconstructed and collected manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing tested statistical functions and deterministic batch harnesses can reuse implementation and scenario handling.
tasks.still_hard: Novel design assumptions, model adequacy and choosing a defensible method.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician judges what must be tested and what the results mean for the actual study.

ambition.what: Test additional explicitly specified sensitivity scenarios without rebuilding batch handling.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; study owner approves methodological inputs and permitted test data

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: tested statistical-package functions and reproducible simulation harnesses can implement and compare specified designs.

assumptions: The statistician supplies the question, methods, parameters and scenarios in s1-s3; no model invents a design or provides free assumptions.
s4 replaces manual scenario preparation and result collection, not unattended simulation runtime. Existing equivalent batch tooling earns no additional gain.
Implementation checks and actual written comparison remain in s3 and s5; failed benchmarks or unexplained scenario failures stop finalization.
Illustrative gross saving 23.75 per 100 task hours, upkeep 4, net 19.75; same-workspace save earns no gain. No study execution or external submission is proposed.
unknowns: Existing reusable implementation coverage and scenario handling effort
research_questions: Which repeated simulation preparation and result collection steps are manual today?

already_counted.description: Specify designs and scenarios, implement and check candidates and interpret and record actual test findings

incremental.description: Maintain and benchmark reusable functions and scenario harnesses

approvals.approved_version: Final design comparison and test record checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured candidate-design testing scenario; only reusable implementation and manual scenario handling reduced, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify data relationships, trends and research limitations

steps.what: Define the actual analysis questions and methods and inspect the prepared dataset, source provenance and relevant study context
inputs: Actual research question and study context
outputs: Checked analysis inputs and statistician-authored analysis specification

steps.what: Assemble and execute the specified relationship and trend analyses using reusable checked statistical code
inputs: Checked dataset and actual analysis specification from s1
outputs: Specified relationship and trend outputs with dataset and method identifiers

steps.what: Prepare and execute the specified diagnostics and sensitivity comparisons for missingness, model assumptions and relevant candidate factors
inputs: Explicit diagnostic and sensitivity specification from s1
outputs: Diagnostic and sensitivity output pack with failures and warnings

steps.what: Check actual outputs and warnings and interpret relationships, trends, uncertainty and factors that could affect the research results
inputs: Study context and original analysis specification
outputs: Checked interpretation, limitations and unresolved methodological issues

steps.what: Write and check the actual analysis findings and limitations against the checked outputs
inputs: Checked interpretation and actual output references
outputs: Final checked analysis record

steps.what: Save the final checked analysis record in its existing workspace
outputs: Saved analysis findings and limitations

tasks.design: Build reusable deterministic analysis and diagnostic routines in {DATA_PLATFORM} from the statistician's explicit methods. The statistician checks outputs, interprets relationships and possible confounding or bias, and writes and checks the findings in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated analysis and diagnostic setup and collecting comparable output packs may be manual.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned statistical routines can assemble specified analyses and diagnostics consistently.
tasks.still_hard: Method adequacy, confounding, measurement bias and distinguishing association from a causal explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician connects the actual study context to what the results can support.

ambition.what: Recheck specified relationships and sensitivities when a validated dataset version changes.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; data and study owners approve analysis access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic statistical pipelines can assemble specified analyses and diagnostic outputs while interpretation remains expert work.

assumptions: An actual prepared dataset and provenance are inputs, produced by task 8957 or the real data-preparation workflow. Its capture and cleaning are counted there once, not silently repeated or made free here.
s1 authors the actual methods and diagnostics; missing study context or failed source checks stops analysis. No free-text question becomes an unreviewed statistical method.
s2 and s3 replace currently manual repeated setup and output assembly, not existing numerical-engine runtime or equivalent automated analysis.
Illustrative gross saving 45 per 100 task hours, upkeep 5, net 40; interpretation and actual written findings are retained, and same-workspace saving earns no gain.
unknowns: Current reusable analysis coverage and manual diagnostic assembly effort
research_questions: Which standard analyses and sensitivity output packs are manually reconstructed for each dataset version?

already_counted.description: Check and specify actual analysis, interpret outputs and write and check findings

incremental.description: Maintain analysis and diagnostic routines and benchmark changed code

approvals.approved_version: Final analysis record checked in s5; edits require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured repeated-analysis scenario with manual setup today; actual method choice, interpretation and record writing retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present results with charts, bullets and graphs

steps.what: Select and check the actual statistical and nonstatistical results and formulate the conclusions and limitations for this audience
inputs: Actual checked analysis outputs and nonstatistical findings
outputs: Checked result set and statistician-authored presentation points

steps.what: Assemble the specified charts and graphs from checked result tables into the existing presentation template
inputs: Approved chart specifications and existing template
outputs: Draft presentation with source-linked charts and graphs

steps.what: Draft and edit presentation bullets from the statistician's checked conclusions and limitations
outputs: Draft presentation bullets preserving the supplied findings and caveats

loop.purpose: Express already checked conclusions in concise audience-appropriate bullets
loop.output: Draft bullets linked to supplied findings
loop.check: Statistican edits wording and checks every claim, number and caveat against the actual outputs in s4
loop.stop: Unsupported inference, changed number or missing caveat returns to the statistician; no presentation
loop.why_not_simpler: Audience wording requires semantic drafting; numerical charts and table placement remain deterministic

steps.what: Check the final complete presentation, every chart and number, bullets, confidentiality and audience suitability
inputs: Actual checked source outputs and audience
outputs: Final checked presentation

steps.what: Save the final checked presentation in the same document workspace
outputs: Saved final presentation

steps.what: Present the checked results, charts and graphs at the actual client meeting or conference and answer audience questions
outputs: Results explained to the audience and questions addressed

tasks.design: Assemble source-linked charts deterministically from {DATA_PLATFORM} into {DOCS}, then draft bullets only from the statistician's own checked findings. The statistician checks the final presentation before saving and presenting it and retains live explanation and questions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual chart placement and first-draft bullet wording can repeat work after the analysis is complete.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing chart templates and bounded prose drafting can assemble a checked result set into presentation form.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the right message and explaining uncertainty to a specific audience.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician interprets audience questions and explains what the results do and do not support.

ambition.what: Reduce actual presentation preparation while retaining substantive communication.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; result owner approves actual audience and disclosure scope

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: chart templates can assemble checked numerical outputs, and a model can draft bullets from supplied conclusions for complete human checking.

assumptions: Actual analysis and nonstatistical findings are already produced by their real workflows; s1 selects and checks them and authors the presentation points. Data preparation and analysis savings are not counted again here.
Chart specifications and source tables are explicit inputs selected in s1; no clean numbers, conclusions or chart choice are generated for free.

This scenario presents to an external client or conference audience; internal meetings use the appropriate internal disclosure process. Unanticipated questions remain human and uncertain answers are deferred for source checking.
s2 replaces manual assembly and placement, not existing chart-rendering runtime. No separate email distribution is promised.
Illustrative gross saving 24.5 per 100 task hours, upkeep 3, net 21.5. Saving the same document earns no gain.
unknowns: Actual manual chart assembly effort and existing template use
research_questions: Which charts and source references are manually placed into recurring presentation packs?

already_counted.description: Select actual findings, review bullet drafts and check the complete presentation

incremental.description: Maintain chart-to-source templates and review draft quality

approvals.approved_version: Final presentation checked in s4; edits require rechecking
Final presentation and audience disclosure checked in s4; changed material requires rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured presentation episode with manual chart assembly and bullet drafting today; actual findings, full checks and live presentation retained, upkeep deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Agree exact source contracts with data owners and retain lineage from raw extracts to results and presentation.
skills_to_grow: Build reproducible preparation and diagnostic pipelines
role.ambitious_version: A statistician who uses reproducible routines for repeated data handling and output assembly while retaining research design, exception judgment, interpretation and communication.
